title: Ops/contribution runbook + rule-pack governance + outcome dashboard + maintenance rotation
context: Post-delivery sustainability keeps the toolkit healthy and broadens it. This documents the ops/contribution runbook, rule-pack governance (including mandatory re-sign-off for sensitive-species generalization changes), an outcome dashboard tracking beneficiary-facing metrics, and a named maintenance rotation. Depends on csp-handoff-016.
objective: Write the ops/contribution runbook, the rule-pack governance process, the outcome-tracking dashboard spec, and establish a named maintenance rotation.
acceptanceCriteria: Runbook covers running a pipeline, adding an adapter, adding/versioning a rule pack, and partner handoff; rule-pack governance requires re-sign-off for any sensitive-species generalization change
Dashboard tracks pilots delivered/used, datasets cleaned, before/after error reduction, reproducibility-replay pass rate, and privacy-gate status (not stars/downloads)
output: docs/ops/runbook.md plus docs/ops/rule-pack-governance.md and docs/ops/outcome-dashboard.md committed to the repo.
